speaker-ecapa.notes: ONNX export of the embedding_model at speechbrain/spkrec-ecapa-voxceleb 0f99f2d0, made by scripts/export_ecapa_onnx.py. Served only from the owner CDN at owner_path (the base is a build-time default, see docs/setup.md#speaker-model); the object at that path is immutable, so a re-export ships under a new filename plus a new pin.
